
# Beta Diversity Analysis - Within Breeds

## Load Data and Plotting Utilities

```{r load_data_04F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load processed plotting data, color schemes, and MAG catalogue data (for genome_metadata)
load("data/macro/plot_data.Rdata")
load("data/data_colors.Rdata")
load("data/MAG_catalogue/data.Rdata")  # Needed for genome_metadata in PCA plots
```

## Beta Diversity Within Breeds

This section analyzes compositional differences within each breed separately, comparing different treatments using PCA and PERMANOVA.

## Broilers - Composition Barplots

```{r composition_barplots_broiler_04F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=7, fig.width=12}
# Create stacked barplots showing order-level composition for broilers
# Using filtered (non-closed) data
p1 <- tidy_plot_genome_counts_filt_30_macro %>%
  filter(treatment != "TF0") %>%
  filter(animal_breed == "broiler") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = animal, y = count, fill = order)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = order_colors[-4], drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Metagenomic Samples", y = "Order composition", fill = "Order") +
  facet_nested(. ~ animal_breed + treatment_expl + age, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Composition of bacterial orders at 30% coverage filtered data (non-closed)")

# Create stacked barplot using closed (100% normalized) data
p2 <- tidy_plot_genome_counts_filt_30_macro_closed %>%
  filter(treatment != "TF0") %>%
  filter(animal_breed == "broiler") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = animal, y = count, fill = order)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = order_colors[-4], drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Metagenomic Samples", y = "Order composition", fill = "Order") +
  facet_nested(. ~ animal_breed + treatment_expl + age, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Composition of bacterial orders at 30% coverage filtered data (closed)")

# Display both plots (commented out - these are combined below)
# p1
# p2
```

## Broilers - PCA Analysis

```{r pca_broiler_prep_04F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, comment=""}
# Prepare wide format data frame for PCA analysis on broilers only
PCA_df <- tidy_plot_genome_counts_filt_30_macro_closed %>%
  filter(animal_breed == "broiler") %>%
  # Remove metadata
  select(genome, microsample, count) %>%
  # Make tidy df into wide df
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = genome,   
    values_from = count,   
    # Fill missing values with 0
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  # Remove taxa (columns) that are zero for all leftover samples (rows)
  select(where(~ any(. != 0))) %>%
  # scale each sample to 100 (= closure to 100, not required, but common)
  mutate(across(-microsample, ~ . / rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))) * 100 )) %>%
  # turn the column 'microsample'into the name of the rows of the df
  column_to_rownames(var = "microsample")


MACRO_sample_metadata <- sample_metadata_macro %>%
  mutate(microsample = sample) %>%
  select(microsample, animal, animal_breed, age, treatment, treatment_expl) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = "MACRO") 



pca_result <- perform_pca(PCA_df, z_delete = TRUE)
# plot_scree(pca_result)  # Scree plot removed
p <- plot_pca(pca_result$pca_result,
         samples_color_metadata = "treatment" , 
         samples_shape_metadata = "age",
         samples_color_value = treatment_colours_bright, 
         loadings_color_metadata = "order", 
         loadings_color_value = order_colors, 
         loadings_taxon_level = "species",
         MACRO_sample_metadata, genome_metadata, order_colors, 
         custom_ggplot_theme)

p2 = p + ggtitle("Broilers")
# p2  # Individual plot commented out - used in combined plot

```


```{r pca_broilers_plot_04F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, comment=""}

p <- plot_pca(pca_result$pca_result,
         samples_color_metadata = "treatment" , 
         samples_shape_metadata = "age",
         samples_color_value = treatment_colours_bright, 
         loadings_color_metadata = "order", 
         loadings_color_value = order_colors, 
         loadings_taxon_level = "species",
         scaling_factor_value = 1.0, 
          loadings_number = 10,
         MACRO_sample_metadata, genome_metadata, order_colors, 
         custom_ggplot_theme,
         add_centroids = TRUE)

p2 = p + ggtitle("Broilers")
# p2  # Individual plot commented out - used in combined plot

```

### PERMANOVA
```{r permanova_broilers_test_04F, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.height = 7, fig.width=10}

# Calculate Euclidean distance on CLR data
pca_animals_dist_matrix <- vegdist(pca_result$df_clr_dist, method = "euclidean")

# Make sure that filtered df and metadata have the same number & order of rows
pca_animals_metadata_adonis <- plot_data_stats_macro %>%
  filter(microsample %in% rownames(pca_result$df_clr_dist)) %>%
  arrange(match(microsample, rownames(pca_result$df_clr_dist))) %>%
  select(microsample, animal_breed, treatment, age)
all(pca_animals_metadata_adonis$microsample == rownames(pca_result$df_clr_dist))

# Run PERMANOVA
adonis2_result <- adonis2(
  pca_animals_dist_matrix ~ treatment,
  data = pca_animals_metadata_adonis,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "terms"
)

# Display PERMANOVA results as formatted table
adonis2_table <- as.data.frame(adonis2_result)
knitr::kable(adonis2_table, digits = 4, caption = "PERMANOVA results for beta diversity within breed")
```

```{r permanova_broilers_age_04F, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.height = 7, fig.width=10}
# #  Pick one treatment
# trt <- "TF1"
# #Subset metadata safely — preserves sample IDs as rownames
# subset_meta <- pca_animals_metadata_adonis[
#   pca_animals_metadata_adonis$treatment == trt, ,
#   drop = FALSE
# ]
# #  Restore the correct sample IDs as rownames
# rownames(subset_meta) <- subset_meta$microsample
# subset_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(pca_animals_dist_matrix)[
#   rownames(subset_meta),
#   rownames(subset_meta)
# ])
# adonis_res_TF1 <- adonis2(subset_dist ~ age, data = subset_meta, permutations = 999)

# LOOP
treatments <- unique(pca_animals_metadata_adonis$treatment)

results_age <- map_dfr(treatments, function(trt) {
  
  # Subset metadata and restore proper sample IDs
  subset_meta <- pca_animals_metadata_adonis[
    pca_animals_metadata_adonis$treatment == trt, ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  rownames(subset_meta) <- subset_meta$microsample
  
  # Subset the distance matrix to those samples
  subset_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(pca_animals_dist_matrix)[
    rownames(subset_meta),
    rownames(subset_meta)
  ])
  
  # Run PERMANOVA for age within this treatment
  adonis_res <- adonis2(subset_dist ~ age, data = subset_meta, permutations = 999)
  
  # Extract R² and p-value
  data.frame(
    Treatment = trt,
    R2 = adonis_res$R2[1],
    p_value = adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
})

results_age

```
